sourceRecord.sourceWikitext: __NOTOC__ {{Recipe summary | Category = Broth and stock recipes | Difficulty = 2 }} {{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of France|French cuisine]] ==Ingredients== * 5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]] shank, sawn into 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] lengths * 2 lb veal shin bones, sawn into 2-inch lengths * 1 lb veal marrow bones * 2 lb [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] carcasses * ½ lb (2 medium) [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], in medium [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]] * 4 oz (2 medium) [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], peeled and in medium dice * 4 oz (2 stalks) [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]] with leaves, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] * 4 oz (2 medium) [[Cookbook:Leek|leeks]] including 2 inches of the green part, sliced and washed thoroughly * 1 large clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], crushed * 10 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], bruised * 2 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaf]] * ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] whole black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]] * 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * 2 medium ripe [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] (for brown stock only), peeled, seeded, juiced, and diced *½ cup tomato purée (for brown stock only) ==Procedure== ===Fond blanc (white stock)=== #Put the veal and chicken bones into a stock pot, and add enough water to cover the bones by 2 inches. #Bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over medium heat, and skim off any scum as it forms. Simmer for 30 minutes—do not boil. #Add the vegetables and seasonings and simmer for 6 to 8 hours. #Remove the bones with [[Cookbook:Tongs|tongs]] or a [[Cookbook:Spider|spider]] and strain into another container. Rinse the pot. #Strain the stock back into the stock pot through a double layer of damp [[Cookbook:Cheesecloth|cheesecloth]]. #Place the pot in a sink of cold water and allow to cool. Refrigerate. #Remove from the refrigerator and lift off the layer of fat. #Divide into suitably sized portions and freeze. ===Fond brun (brown stock)=== #[[Cookbook:Browning|Brown]] the bones and vegetables in a 400°F (180°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] in 2 tablespoons of [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], turning from time to time. Do not allow them to burn. #Add bones and vegetables to the stock pot, then [[Cookbook:Deglazing|deglaze]] the browning pan with water, and add it to the pot. #[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 30 minutes, removing scum as it forms. #Add the tomato and the tomato purée and proceed with the recipe as above. ==Notes, tips, and variations== *If the stock is not frozen it may be kept covered in the refrigerator for 3–4 days. steps.text: Put the veal and chicken bones into a stock pot, and add enough water to cover the bones by 2 inches.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and skim off any scum as it forms. Simmer for 30 minutes—do not boil.
Add the vegetables and seasonings and simmer for 6 to 8 hours.
Remove the bones with tongs or a spider and strain into another container. Rinse the pot.
Strain the stock back into the stock pot through a double layer of damp cheesecloth.
Place the pot in a sink of cold water and allow to cool. Refrigerate.
Remove from the refrigerator and lift off the layer of fat.
Divide into suitably sized portions and freeze.
Brown the bones and vegetables in a 400°F (180°C) oven in 2 tablespoons of butter, turning from time to time. Do not allow them to burn.
Add bones and vegetables to the stock pot, then deglaze the browning pan with water, and add it to the pot.
Simmer for 30 minutes, removing scum as it forms.
Add the tomato and the tomato purée and proceed with the recipe as above.
